definitions.short: properly, to join ; used only as a denominative from 681 ; to separate ; hence, to select , refuse , contract
definitions.full: H680. atsal [ אָצַל ] verb denominative lay aside, reserve, withdraw, withhold — Qal Perfect אָצַלְתָּ Gen 27:36 ; אָצַלְתִּי Eccl 2:10 ; וְאָֽצַלְתִּ֫י consecutive Num 11:17 ; — reserve , בְרָכָה לִי Gen 27:36 ; ( withdraw ), set apart מִןהָֿרוּחַ Num 11:17 ; withhold מֵהֶם Eccl 2:10 . Niph`al Perfect נֶאֱצַל Ezek 42:6 be withdrawn , i.e. shortened or narrowed. Hiph`il Imperfect וַיָּאצֶל Num 11:25 (Kö 1. 390 ) = Qal 11:17 .
